title: Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.17105v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. translated_title: 基于非人灵长类肝脏组织病理学预测乙醇饮酒状态：少样本视觉-语言模型中参数高效微调的概念验证
translated_abstract: 将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与参数高效微调（PEFT）相结合，为计算病理学中的少样本全切片图像（WSI）分类提供了一种有前景的方法。本研究评估了该方法在从非人灵长类肝脏组织病理学预测乙醇饮酒状态方面的效果。研究在猴子酒精组织研究资源（MATRR）的一个子集上，将适配器方法与非PEFT配置进行了对比评估。所有被评估的PEFT配置均取得了比非PEFT基线更高的平均平衡准确率。例如，在四样本设置下，单独使用基于注意力的多示例学习（ABMIL）仅达到43.5%的平均平衡准确率，而添加适配器后达到了78.1%。定性注意力分析表明，文本通路的适配产生局部化的注意力热图，而视觉通路的适配产生更为弥散的注意力热图。病理学家的审查在各配置中识别出了相似的组织学特征。
tldr: 该研究证明，在少样本设定下，通过适配器进行参数高效微调可显著提升视觉-语言模型从非人灵长类肝脏病理切片预测饮酒状态的能力，将ABMIL的平均平衡准确率从43.5%大幅提高至78.1%。
en_tdlr: This study provides proof of concept that parameter-efficient fine-tuning with adapters substantially improves few-shot vision-language models for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology, raising ABMIL's mean balanced accuracy from 43.5% to 78.1% in the four-shot setting.
